name: Owl. Calm Home
description: Owl.'s calm home page for any Chromium browser: a big clock, the line of your day, your favourites, shortcuts, the weather, Wi-Fi and volume, the pages you left, and day, week and month reports of where your time goes. Everything stays on this computer.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src https://api.open-meteo.com https://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'
